description: This file defines an abstract base class for publisher actors within an Akka-based messaging system. It manages connection targets, monitors, message dispatching, header/header mapping, acknowledgments, and error handling for messaging targets, serving as a foundational component for message publishing in the Eclipse Ditto connectivity framework.

classes.name: BasePublisherActor
classes.description: An abstract Akka actor class serving as the base for message publisher actors, managing connection targets, monitoring, message dispatch, acknowledgments, and error escalation within the Eclipse Ditto connectivity framework.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Creates the message handler for the actor, setting up default and customizable message processing logic.

methods.name: sendMultiMappedOutboundSignal
methods.description: Handles sending multiple mapped outbound signals, managing response, acknowledgment, and error processing.

methods.name: shouldPublishAcknowledgement
methods.description: Abstract method for determining if an acknowledgment should be sent for a specific acknowledgement.

methods.name: issueAcknowledgements
methods.description: Dispatches acknowledgments back to the sender based on collected acknowledgment data.

methods.name: sendBackResponses
methods.description: Sends command responses to the sender for non-acknowledgment responses.

methods.name: getExceptionConverter
methods.description: Provides a converter from exceptions to acknowledgments; overridable for custom handling.

methods.name: aggregateNonNullFutures
methods.description: Utility to combine multiple CompletableFutures into a single list once all complete.

methods.name: appendConnectionId
methods.description: Associates a connection ID with acknowledgments.

methods.name: computeMaxAckPayloadBytesForSignal
methods.description: Calculates the maximum payload size for acknowledgments based on configuration.

methods.name: sendMappedOutboundSignal
methods.description: Dispatches a mapped outbound signal to its targets, considering acknowledgement and size constraints.

methods.name: getSendingContext
methods.description: Determines the appropriate sending context for a mapped outbound signal, based on its reply target or targets.

methods.name: isResponseOrErrorOrSearchEvent
methods.description: Checks whether an outbound signal is a response, error, or search event, influencing its publishing logic.

methods.name: getReplyTargetByIndex
methods.description: Retrieves a reply target by its index if within bounds.

methods.name: getSendingContextForReplyTarget
methods.description: Constructs a sending context for a reply target.

methods.name: getSendingContextForTarget
methods.description: Constructs a sending context for a specific target, including monitors.

methods.name: tryToPublishToGenericTarget
methods.description: Attempts to publish a message to a generic target, catching exceptions to handle failures.

methods.name: publishToGenericTarget
methods.description: Publishes a message to a resolved target, applying header mappings and size constraints.

methods.name: applyHeaderMapping
methods.description: Applies header mappings to an outbound signal to create an external message.

methods.name: preEnhancement
methods.description: Abstract hook for subclasses to add custom message handlers before default handlers.

methods.name: postEnhancement
methods.description: Abstract hook for subclasses to add custom message handlers after default handlers.

methods.name: toPublishTarget
methods.description: Abstract method converting a string address to a publisher target of type T.

methods.name: publishMessage
methods.description: Abstract method to publish a message and return a future response, including acknowledgments.

methods.name: decodeAsHumanReadable
methods.description: Decodes a ByteBuffer into a string using the message's charset, for diagnostics.

methods.name: getCharsetFromMessage
methods.description: Determines the charset to decode message content based on content type.

methods.name: escalate
methods.description: Raises a failure alert to trigger actor restart, escalating exceptions.

methods.name: getAcknowledgementLabel
methods.description: Extracts the acknowledgment label from a target if resolvable.

methods.name: resolveTargetAddress
methods.description: Resolves a potentially placeholdered address string into an actual address, if resolvable.

methods.name: getInstanceIdentifier
methods.description: Returns a unique identifier for this instance of the publisher.

methods.name: determineCharset
methods.description: Selects a charset based on content type for decoding message content.

methods.name: isTargetAckRequested
methods.description: Checks if a target has requested acknowledgment for a given signal.

methods.name: isLiveSignal
methods.description: Checks whether a signal is a 'live' type, e.g., message or recognized thing command.
